note: Where each Entra fixture and simulator behaviour comes from. Retrieved 2026-11-05. Microsoft's pages are the reference; nothing here was captured from a live tenant (no free Entra tenant is available), so real-tenant quirks stay unverified (see T109).

used_for: claims.json: claim names and formats (aud, iss, iat, nbf, exp, name, oid, preferred_username, sub, tid, uti, rh, ver, email)
preferred_username and email are mutable and must not be used for authorization
sub is pairwise per application id; oid is the same across applications
iss carries the tenant GUID and ends in /v2.0; the personal-account tenant is 9188040d-6c67-4c5b-b112-36a304b66dad
the groups overage pointer: _claim_names.groups = src1 and _claim_sources.src1.endpoint
discovery.json: key set and endpoint paths (oauth2/v2.0/authorize, oauth2/v2.0/token, discovery/v2.0/keys)
the multi-tenant document's issuer is the literal template https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantid}/v2.0
subject_types_supported is pairwise; ID tokens are RS256
AADSTS54005: authorization code already redeemed (replayed code)
AADSTS90002: tenant not found (unknown tenant in the path)

not_from_microsoft: claim values (names, ids, email addresses) are made up
the claim-overage endpoint host is the Graph URL from the claims reference; the gateway must never fetch it
